mapper.select: select * from( SELECT to_number(SUBSTR (badge, INSTR (badge,#{compAbbr}, 1, 1)+length(#{compAbbr}))) badge FROM SMT_STAFF WHERE comp_id=#{compId} and badge LIKE CONCAT(#{compAbbr},'%') AND BADGE NOT LIKE CONCAT('LGLS','%') ORDER BY BADGE DESC) where rownum=1
select * from SMT_STAFF WHERE CREATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND CREATE_TIME < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
select * from SMT_STAFF WHERE CREATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND status != 0
select st.id,st.pzid,st.badge,st.comp_Id,st.welfare_Level,st.create_Time,st.status,st.jche_Id from SMT_STAFF st WHERE st.CREATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND st.status != 0

SELECT SVP.ID ,SVP.PARK_ID,SVP.VEHICLE_PLATE VEHICLEPLATE , SP.PARK_NAME PARKNAME , SVP.STATUS ,SVP.REASON FROM SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY SVP INNER JOIN SMT_PARK SP ON SVP.PARK_ID=SP.ID
WHERE SVP.VEHICLE_ID=#{vehiclePlate}

SELECT SV.VEHICLE_PLATE,SV.VEHICLE_BRAND, SV.VEHICLE_COLOR,SV.VEHICLE_TYPE,SVA.REASON, SV.DRIVER_LICENSE_ID,SV.DRIVINGL_LICENSE_ID FROM SMT_VEHICLE SV INNER JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY SVA ON SV.ID=SVA.VEHICLE_ID WHERE SVA.ID=#{id}

SELECT SV.ID, SV.VEHICLE_PLATE,SV.VEHICLE_BRAND,SV.VEHICLE_COLOR,SV.VEHICLE_TYPE, SV.DRIVER_LICENSE_ID,SV.DRIVINGL_LICENSE_ID FROM SMT_VEHICLE SV INNER JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS ON SV.ID=SVS.VEHICLE_ID AND SV.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SS.ID=SVS.STAFF_ID
WHERE SS.BADGE=#{badge}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_STAFF SET PHONE=#{phone} WHERE badge=#{badge}
mapper.select:
select AUTH_NAME authName from SMT_APP_STAFF_AUTH staff
inner join SMT_APP_AUTH auth
on STAFF.AUTH_ID=AUTH.ID
where STAFF_ID=#{staffId}

select park.park_name parkName,area.pid pId,area.area_name areaName,device.device_name deviceName from SMT_STAFF_DEVICE_AUTH auth
inner join SMT_DEVICE_AUTHORITY_RELATION rela
on AUTH.AUTH_ID=rela.AUTHORITY_ID
inner join SMT_DEVICE_AREA dar
ON rela.device_id=dar.device_id
inner join SMT_DEVICE device on device.id=dar.device_id
inner join SMT_AREA area on area.id=dar.area_id
inner join SMT_PARK park on park.id =area.park_id
where auth.id = #{authId}

SELECT STAFF.ID,BADGE,STAFF.NAME,COMP_NAME,DEP_NAME,JCHE_NAME,JOB_NAME,STAFF.CREATE_TIME,SEQ_ID FROM SMT_STAFF STAFF
APPLICATION_ID is not null
AND NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
AND BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
AND CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND STAFF.COMP_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SPB.COMP_ID from SMT_PARK_BU SPB
SPB.PARK_ID IN
#{id}
)
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC,STAFF.NAME ASC
select * from ( select BADGE,NAME,DEP_NAME from SMT_STAFF where BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{badge}),'%') ORDER BY create_time DESC ) where rownum < 11
select * from SMT_STAFF WHERE LOWER(BADGE) = LOWER(#{badge})

SELECT DISTINCT STAFF.ID, STAFF.BADGE, STAFF.NAME, STAFF.STATUS FROM SMT_STAFF STAFF LEFT JOIN SMT_PARK_BU EBU ON EBU.COMP_ID = STAFF.COMP_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_ORGANIZE_RELATION OBU ON OBU.ID = STAFF.COMP_ID WHERE STAFF.COMP_ID IS NOT NULL AND ( EBU.PARK_ID = #{parkId} OR OBU.PARK_ID = #{parkId} )
AND STAFF.BADGE = #{badge}
AND STAFF.STATUS != 0
AND STAFF.STATUS = 0
ORDER BY STAFF.BADGE ASC
mapper.update: update SMT_STAFF set REPORT_TO = null where ID = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT ID,BADGE,NAME,PHONE, case when OPARK_ID IS NOT NULL then OPARK_ID when EPARK_ID IS NOT NULL then EPARK_ID ELSE NULL END PARK_ID FROM ( SELECT STAFF.ID ID, STAFF.BADGE BADGE, STAFF.NAME NAME, STAFF.PHONE PHONE, EBU.PARK_ID EPARK_ID, OBU.PARK_ID OPARK_ID FROM SMT_STAFF STAFF LEFT JOIN SMT_PARK_BU EBU ON EBU.ID = STAFF.COMP_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_ORGANIZE_RELATION OBU ON OBU.ID = STAFF.COMP_ID
STAFF.COMP_ID is not null AND STAFF.STATUS != 0
AND STAFF.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{createTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND STAFF.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{createTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + 1
AND ( EBU.PARK_ID = #{parkId} OR OBU.PARK_ID = #{parkId} ) )
